ideas.name: Rotulim (example)
ideas.one_line: Kids' daily chewable multivitamin by quarterly subscription, for label-reading parents

reasons.offers: Real pain (guilt, picky eaters) but regulation forbids the outcome claims parents pay for
reasons.monopoly: No moat beyond brand; Alpha Kids already premium at ~R$58/month
reasons.product: Tight focus (1 SKU, 1 channel) and a designed daily ritual
reasons.fit: Founder has budget and a written study, no supplement experience yet
reasons.gap: No Brazilian brand found combining per-lot lab reports, taste guarantee and a kids' ritual
reasons.regulatory: Anvisa notification, child-specific limits, claim review on every ad
reasons.variable_cost: Founder's study hypotheses, no manufacturer quote

ideas.name: Example that fails
ideas.one_line: A café that would need a lease bigger than the budget
